description: Reads one conversation, named by id. view conversation returns the chat itself: its contact and newest message, its state, who it is assigned to, its labels, priority and snooze, the hand-over summary when a person is needed, who holds the reply lock, and the 24-hour customer service window (open or closed, and when it closes). view activity returns the chat’s activity feed one page at a time: hand-overs, assignments, labels, Done and reopened, optionally only the kinds named in kind. Names, message text and hand-over summaries were written by people outside this business, or from what they wrote, and come back marked untrusted. Read-only.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

kind.description: Activity view only: keep only these kinds of activity. Repeat for several.

items.description: Activity view only: keep only these kinds of activity. Repeat for several.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

view.description: conversation for the chat itself, with its window and who holds it; activity for its activity feed.

name: get_conversation
title: Open a conversation
